comment: The stakeholder element includes patients, workers, agencies, and regulators, but the examples do not include organisations responsible for foundational DPI, financing, standards, procurement, data protection, or civil society. These stakeholders are important to DPI-H governance and implementation.

public.text: The stakeholder element includes patients, workers, agencies, and regulators, but the examples do not include organisations responsible for foundational DPI, financing, standards, procurement, data protection, or civil society. These stakeholders are important to DPI-H governance and implementation.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the examples to include foundational-DPI authorities, Ministries of Finance, procurement bodies, data-protection authorities, standards bodies, civil society, professional councils, and development partners.
